input._script:
using CUDA
using JSON3
sh(c) = try replace(strip(read(`bash -c $c`, String)), "\n"=>" | ") catch e; "ERR" end
r = Dict{String,Any}()
r["env_before"] = get(ENV, "JACC_BACKEND", "<unset>")
ENV["JACC_BACKEND"] = "CUDA"
try
    import JACC
    r["import"] = "ok"
    r["jacc_version"] = try string(pkgversion(JACC)) catch e; "?" end
    r["names"] = string(sort(map(string, names(JACC))))
    for f in ("set_backend","backend","default_backend","JACCPreferences","get_backend")
        r["has_"*f] = isdefined(JACC, Symbol(f))
    end
catch e
    r["import"] = "ERR: "*sprint(showerror, e)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe"=>r)))
